entities.name: Tacenda Verlasen
entities.description: A songmage and possible planeswalker from Innistrad, twin of Willia, whose Warding Song protects against monsters and who becomes host of the Bog Entity.

entities.name: Willia Verlasen
entities.description: Tacenda's twin, a fearsome sword-wielding warrior who guards the Seelenstone, turns to the Bog and is killed by Tacenda.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: A man with an Entity who helps Tacenda investigate Verlasen's fate.

entities.name: Verlasen
entities.description: The hometown of the twins in the Approaches of Kessig, made safe by their protection until it was attacked by geists.

entities.name: Approaches of Kessig
entities.description: The region where the twins were born.

entities.name: Lord of the Manor
entities.description: The figure Tacenda believes killed Willia and whose voice the attacking geists seemed to have.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Geists unaffected by Tacenda's song that drain souls from the villagers of Verlasen, created from souls controlled by the Bog.

entities.name: Bog Entity
entities.description: An entity whose power was meant to be hidden in the Bog, partly carried by Tacenda and Willia, and made whole inside Tacenda.

entities.name: Davriel's Entity
entities.description: The entity bound to Davriel that confirmed Tacenda carried part of the Bog Entity.

entities.name: Nameless Angel
entities.description: An angel worshipped at a church, murdered by the Priory's people and struck by Emrakul's madness; its soul urges Tacenda to use a new song.

entities.name: Priory
entities.description: The place where Willia became an acolyte and guarded the Seelenstone.

entities.name: Seelenstone
entities.description: A stone that spoke to Willia, holding souls, which she broke to release them for the Bog Entity.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi whose madness struck the Nameless Angel.

entities.name: Brandon Sanderson
entities.description: The author who says it is not confirmed Tacenda planeswalked.

events.summary: Tacenda and Willia, born cursed to be blind by turns, grow into protectors of Verlasen.
events.quote: There was never a time that both could see.

events.summary: The twins' parents are killed in the woods, Willia is allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor, and geists drain the villagers' souls.
events.quote: Tacenda's Song of Protection failed to ward the geists off

events.summary: Tacenda attacks the Lord of the Manor, Davriel, with a rusty pick; he brushes it off and agrees to help her.
events.quote: attempted to kill him with a rusty pick

events.summary: Tacenda and Davriel investigate and deduce the Whisperers came from the Bog and that a betrayer had let the geists into the church.
events.quote: Davriel reasoned that they were from the Bog

events.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity; the Bog is found empty and Whisperers besiege them.
events.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

events.summary: At the Priory, they discover Willia is alive and the key actor in the conflict.
events.quote: its major actor was none other than Tacenda's, thought to be deceased, sister Willia!

events.summary: Willia, led on by the Seelenstone, accidentally kills her parents, loses faith and serves the Bog Entity, preparing to kill her sister.
events.quote: She didn't mean to kill them.

events.summary: Tacenda finds the dead Nameless Angel, learns a new joyful song, defeats the Whisperers and, with Davriel, kills Willia, making the Bog Entity whole inside her.
events.quote: the Bog Entity was made whole inside Tacenda

events.summary: Tacenda absorbs ten thousand souls, releases some, and vanishes.

relations.quote: Tacenda and her twin sister Willia

relations.note: Overcame and killed her with Davriel's help.
relations.quote: she also overcame and killed Willia
he decided to assist her in figuring out what happened to Verlasen
